description: This file defines a REST API class for managing dashboard filter states in Apache Superset, including endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting filter state data, with associated Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: DashboardFilterStateRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class for managing dashboard filter states, extending TemporaryCacheRestApi, with methods for CRUD operations on filter state data.

methods.name: get_create_command
methods.description: Returns the command class for creating filter states.

methods.name: get_update_command
methods.description: Returns the command class for updating filter states.

methods.name: get_get_command
methods.description: Returns the command class for retrieving filter states.

methods.name: get_delete_command
methods.description: Returns the command class for deleting filter states.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new filter state for a dashboard.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing filter state.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a filter state value.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a filter state.
